how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-elwynn-forest-03.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:91732:title: Good Steel
rows.quest:91732:obj:0: Collect 4 ⟦E1⟧ from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.
rows.quest:91733:title: Downstream
rows.quest:91733:obj:0: Collect the ⟦E2⟧, ⟦E3⟧, and ⟦E4⟧ that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.
rows.quest:91733:details:0: I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.
rows.quest:91733:details:1: Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a ⟦E5⟧ of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?
rows.quest:176:obj:0: Slay the gnoll Hogger and bring his ⟦E6⟧ to Marshal Dughan.
rows.quest:176:details:1: BA huge gnoll, Hogger, is prowling the woods in southwestern Elwynn. He has overpowered all attempts at his capture.
rows.quest:176:details:2: The ⟦E7⟧ Army has placed a generous bounty on the Gnoll. To earn the reward, bounty hunters should bring proof of Hogger's demise to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
rows.quest:176:progress:0: Yes, Hogger has been a real pain for me and my men. You have something to report about the beast?
rows.quest:176:completion:0: Hah! Well done! I was starting to think no one would take down that monster!
rows.quest:176:completion:1: Here you are, ⟦1⟧. And thanks - that Gnoll was giving me a headache the size of Blackrock Spire!
rows.quest:92745:title: Toxic Soil (part 3)
rows.quest:92745:obj:0: Slay 4 Kobold Diggers in the Jangolode Mine and 6 Riverpaw Miners in the Gold Coast Quarry.
rows.quest:92745:details:0: The well samples you collected contain toxic metals! If we do not put an end to this corruption quickly, it will be decades before crops can grow in this soil again.
rows.quest:92745:details:1: The Defias have seized the mines of and use creatures as labor to strip their resources. Disrupt them by slaying their miners in the Jangolode Mine to the north, and the Gold Coast Quarry to the west.
